problem: nltl:hullStructuralSteelGrade is not required or range-constrained, so a plating with no grade or a malformed grade bypasses all grade-dependent yield-strength rules.
required_change: Require exactly one nltl:hullStructuralSteelGrade value and constrain it to an IRI of class nltl:steelGradeValue before applying the yield-strength rules.
regression_guard: Preserve mandatory, single-valued, canonical steel-grade applicability so missing or malformed grades cannot bypass yield validation.

problem: The query unconditionally accepts every numeric yield strength for grades other than the two named grade values, without establishing that a substituted actual value is accepted; it also provides no approved-substitution pathway where the clause permits one.
required_change: Encode the prescribed normal- and high-strength rules together with an explicit conditional pathway for a different actual yield strength only when its acceptance is established using the available approval semantics.
regression_guard: Do not allow arbitrary yield strengths merely because the steel grade is not one of the two named values, and preserve the clause's accepted-actual-value substitution pathway.
